pg-tarih-seq.q: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_txns WHERE txn_time >= '2024-11-01' AND txn_time < '2024-12-01'

pg-tarih-ix.q: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_txns WHERE txn_time >= '2024-11-01' AND txn_time < '2024-12-01'

pg-tarih-fn.q: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_txns WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM txn_time) = 2024 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM txn_time) = 11

pg-tek-gun.q: SELECT txn_id, amount FROM bank_txns WHERE txn_time >= '2024-11-01' AND txn_time < '2024-11-02'

pg-exists.q: SELECT c.customer_id FROM bank_customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_accounts a WHERE a.customer_id = c.customer_id)

pg-in.q: SELECT c.customer_id FROM bank_customers c WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM bank_accounts a)

pg-distinct.q: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id FROM bank_customers c JOIN bank_accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id

pg-nested.q: SELECT a.customer_id, t.amount FROM bank_accounts a JOIN bank_txns t ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.account_id = 100019

pg-hash.q: SELECT a.customer_id, COUNT(*) FROM bank_txns t JOIN bank_accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.customer_id

pg-merge.q: SELECT o.order_id, l.item_id FROM lk_orders o JOIN lk_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id ORDER BY o.order_id

pg-offset.q: SELECT order_id, placed_at FROM lk_orders ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 10 OFFSET 5000

pg-keyset.q: SELECT order_id, placed_at FROM lk_orders WHERE order_id > 5000 ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 10

pg-secici-yaygin.q: SELECT txn_id, amount FROM bank_txns WHERE txn_type = 'kart_harcama'

pg-secici-nadir.q: SELECT txn_id, amount FROM bank_txns WHERE txn_type = 'faiz'

pg-bolum-iyi.q: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tx_bolum WHERE txn_time >= '2024-11-01' AND txn_time < '2024-12-01'

pg-bolum-fn.q: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tx_bolum WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM txn_time) = 11

pg-bolum-alt.q: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tx_bolum WHERE txn_time >= (SELECT MAX(txn_time) - INTERVAL '30 days' FROM bank_txns)

pg-kapsama-yok.kur: CREATE INDEX ix_hesap_zaman ON bank_txns (account_id, txn_time)
pg-kapsama-yok.q: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM bank_txns WHERE account_id = 100019 AND txn_time >= '2024-01-01'

pg-kapsama-var.kur: CREATE INDEX ix_hesap_zaman ON bank_txns (account_id, txn_time) INCLUDE (amount)
pg-kapsama-var.q: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM bank_txns WHERE account_id = 100019 AND txn_time >= '2024-01-01'

pg-sira-iyi.kur: CREATE INDEX ix_a ON bank_txns (txn_type, txn_time)
pg-sira-iyi.q: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_txns WHERE txn_type = 'faiz' AND txn_time >= '2024-11-01' AND txn_time < '2024-12-01'

pg-sira-kotu.kur: CREATE INDEX ix_b ON bank_txns (txn_time, txn_type)
pg-sira-kotu.q: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_txns WHERE txn_type = 'faiz' AND txn_time >= '2024-11-01' AND txn_time < '2024-12-01'

pg-cte-acik.q: WITH t AS (SELECT txn_id, txn_time FROM bank_txns) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t WHERE txn_time >= '2024-11-01' AND txn_time < '2024-11-02'

pg-cte-mat.q: WITH t AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT txn_id, txn_time FROM bank_txns) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t WHERE txn_time >= '2024-11-01' AND txn_time < '2024-11-02'

pg-tur-iyi.q: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_txns WHERE account_id = 100019

pg-tur-kotu.q: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_txns WHERE account_id::text = '100019'

pg-ifade-ix.q: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_txns WHERE txn_time::date = '2024-11-01'

pg-yildiz.q: SELECT * FROM bank_txns ORDER BY amount DESC

pg-iki-sutun.q: SELECT txn_id, amount FROM bank_txns ORDER BY amount DESC

pg-pencere.q: SELECT txn_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time DESC) AS sira FROM bank_txns

pg-pencere-ix.kur: CREATE INDEX ix_hesap_zaman ON bank_txns (account_id, txn_time DESC)
pg-pencere-ix.q: SELECT txn_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time DESC) AS sira FROM bank_txns

pg-once-birlestir.q: SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) FROM bk_trips t JOIN bk_stations s ON s.station_id = t.start_station GROUP BY s.name

pg-once-topla.q: WITH g AS (SELECT start_station, COUNT(*) AS n FROM bk_trips GROUP BY start_station) SELECT s.name, g.n FROM g JOIN bk_stations s ON s.station_id = g.start_station

pg-bayat.q: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tx_kopya WHERE account_id = 100019

pg-taze.q: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tx_kopya WHERE account_id = 100019

pg-loops.q: SELECT a.account_id, t.amount FROM bank_accounts a JOIN bank_txns t ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.customer_id < 6 AND t.txn_type = 'fatura'

pg-having.q: SELECT txn_type, COUNT(*) FROM bank_txns GROUP BY txn_type HAVING txn_type = 'faiz'
